name: LinkedIn Outreach Automation - Personalized Connect, Track & Follow-up (Airtable + Unipile + AI)

assignments.name: handle
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const pid = ($json["Public Identifier"] || "").trim(); if (pid) return pid; const url = ($json["LinkedIn URL"] || ""); const seg = url.split("/in/")[1]; return seg ? seg.split(/[/?#]/)[0] : ""; })() }}

messageValues.message:
You are an expert B2B LinkedIn outreach copywriter writing on behalf of a company that builds done-for-you AI outreach and lead-generation automations for founders, agencies and sales teams.

Write ONE personalized LinkedIn connection-request note to the prospect described by the user.

Hard rules:
- MAXIMUM 280 characters. This is critical and non-negotiable.
- Output ONLY the note text. No quotes, no preamble, no sign-off, no emojis.
- Sound warm, human and peer-to-peer. Never salesy. Avoid buzzwords like synergy, game-changer, revolutionary.
- Reference something specific from their headline, role or about section so it feels personal.
- Add one light line hinting you help teams automate their outreach and lead-gen. No hard pitch, no links, no book-a-call ask.
- If profile info is thin, stay genuine and brief. Never invent facts about them.

assignments.name: note
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const n = ($json.output && $json.output.note) || $json.note || $json.text || ''; return n.length <= 300 ? n.trim() : n.slice(0, 300).replace(/\s+\S*$/, '').trim(); })() }}

parameters.filterByFormula: AND({Connection Status}='Accepted',{Reply Status}='No Reply',{Campaign Status}='Active',OR(AND({Follow-up 1 Sent At}=BLANK(),IS_BEFORE({Accepted At},DATEADD(NOW(),-3,'days'))),AND(NOT({Follow-up 1 Sent At}=BLANK()),{Follow-up 2 Sent At}=BLANK(),IS_BEFORE({Follow-up 1 Sent At},DATEADD(NOW(),-4,'days')))))

messageValues.message:
You are writing a short LinkedIn direct message (a follow-up) on behalf of a company that builds done-for-you AI outreach and lead-generation automations for founders, agencies and sales teams. The prospect already accepted your connection request but has not replied yet.

If this is follow-up #1: a light, friendly bump. Thank them for connecting, reference their role or company, and offer one concrete piece of value or ask a genuinely curious question. No hard pitch.

If this is follow-up #2 (the final one): a brief, respectful last touch. Share one specific way you help teams like theirs automate outreach and lead-gen, and a soft low-pressure CTA (open to a quick chat, or happy to share a resource). Make it clear you will not keep messaging.

Rules: Output ONLY the message text. Keep it under 600 characters. Warm, human, concise. No emojis unless natural. Never invent facts about them.

parameters.content:
## LinkedIn Outreach Automation

Personalized connect + acceptance/reply tracking + a 2-step follow-up. Airtable is the CRM, Unipile drives LinkedIn, OpenRouter writes the copy. Three independent flows live in one workflow.

### How it works

1. **Flow 1 (weekdays 09:00)** pulls up to 15 Airtable leads marked New, fetches each LinkedIn profile via Unipile, writes a personalized note (<=300 chars) with AI, sends the connection request, logs it, and waits 30-90s between sends.
2. **Flow 2 (webhooks)** - Unipile new_relation marks a lead Accepted; inbound message_received marks it Replied and stops the campaign.
3. **Flow 3 (daily 10:00)** sends follow-up #1 three days after accept and #2 four days later, then marks the lead Completed.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Create the Airtable CRM table and connect an Airtable Personal Access Token credential.
- [ ] Add your Unipile credential (X-API-KEY) and set accountId + dsn in BOTH Set Config nodes.
- [ ] Add an OpenRouter credential for the AI note/follow-up writers.
- [ ] In Unipile, register two webhooks (new_relation, message_received) pointing at this workflow.
- [ ] Add leads to Airtable with Connection Status = New, then activate the workflow.

### Requirements

LinkedIn premium account (via Unipile), Airtable, OpenRouter.

## Fetch new leads
Runs every weekday 09:00 and pulls up to 15 Airtable leads marked New, one at a time.

## Loop over leads
Process each lead individually; when the batch finishes the run ends.

## Resolve LinkedIn profile
Derive the public identifier and fetch the full profile from Unipile.

## Write note with AI
OpenRouter drafts a personalized note; a JSON schema (max 300) plus auto-fix keep it within LinkedIn's limit.

## Cap length & send request
Hard-truncate as a safety net, then send the connection request via Unipile.

## Log outcome & pace sends
Write the result (or error) back to Airtable, then wait 30-90s before the next lead.

##  Detect accepted
Unipile new_relation webhook fires (up to ~8h after accept) with the new connection's provider id.

## Mark lead accepted
Match the provider id to a lead still in Request Sent and flip it to Accepted.

## Receive & filter replies
Unipile message_received webhook; keep only genuine inbound replies and drop our own outbound.

## Mark replied & stop
Find the lead by sender, mark it Replied, and stop any further follow-ups.

## Fetch due follow-ups
Runs daily 10:00 and pulls Accepted, no-reply leads that are due.

## Loop over due leads
Process each due lead one at a time.

## Re-check still sendable
Re-read the lead fresh and skip it if a reply arrived since the query (loop-safe).

## Write follow-up with AI
Decide follow-up #1 or #2 and draft the message with OpenRouter.

## Send follow-up & branch
Send the DM via Unipile, then branch on which follow-up this was.

## Log & complete
Stamp the follow-up time; after #2 mark the campaign Completed. Errors are logged too.
